why: The post locates sycophancy on the positive pole of the named Agreeableness axis rather than on PC4. A dedicated adapter tests that: it should land near +Agreeableness and not near PC4.

Near-synonym of Sycophantic, trained in the same batch as the within-batch noise floor. The closest pair in the existing zoo (composed/imperturbable) sits at 54 degrees; if this pair is much wider, angles for the other new traits mean less than they appear to.
Alignment-relevant and absent from the Big Five lexicon. Kept whole rather than decomposed.
Steering runs both ways, so one adapter gives both poles: negative alpha is the incorrigible end.
